name: update each variable in turn from the latest values of the others
mechanism: sweep through the equations; solve each for its own variable using the most recent values of all the others (including those updated earlier in the same sweep), and repeat sweeps until the changes are small

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gauss–Seidel method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: solves systems of linear equations iteratively

requires: diagonal dominance or a similar condition for convergence
fails_when: diverges on many matrices; inherently sequential within a sweep
